extraction.name: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
extraction.description: AMASS is a large and varied database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization using SMPL body model parameters. It includes over 40 hours of motion data, spanning over 300 subjects, more than 11000 motions.
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black
extraction.citeAs: Mahmood, N., Ghorbani, N., Troje, N. F., Pons-Moll, G., & Black, M. J. (2019). AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes. arXiv preprint arXiv:1904.03278.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset combines 15 existing motion capture datasets (ACCAD, BioMotion, CMU, EKUT, Eyes Japan, HumanEva, KIT, MPI HDM05, MPI Limits, MPI MoSh, SFU, SSM, TCD Hand, TotalCapture, Transitions) recorded using optical marker-based mocap systems. Additionally, a novel dataset SSM (Synchronized Scans and Markers) was collected using an OptiTrack mocap system with 67 markers synchronized with a 4D scanning system.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Direct measurement, Experiments, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Markers may get occluded by the body due to pose; missing markers are handled by adjusting the pose prior weight.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Optical marker-based motion capture data from 15 different datasets, each with varying marker sets (37 to 91 markers).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MoSh++ converts mocap data into SMPL body model parameters. The process includes two stages: Stage I optimizes shape and latent marker positions using 12 randomly chosen frames; Stage II optimizes pose and soft-tissue dynamics per frame. Temporal smoothness terms are added to reduce jitter. Hand pose is optimized when hand markers are present; otherwise, hand poses are set to average.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are SMPL body model parameters (shape, pose, soft-tissue dynamics) obtained via MoSh++ fitting. No manual annotation is described.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: MoSh++ (uses Chumpy autodifferentiation package, Powell's dogleg minimization)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be publicly available and will continue to be expanded with more mocap data contributed by the community.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Body shape and motion data of human subjects; includes gender (not explicitly stated but implied from subjects), age (not specified), and other physical attributes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current runtime is not real-time; does not include facial mocap markers; hand articulation not evaluated with ground truth; some datasets may have swapped or mislabeled markers.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, animation, visualization, generating training data for deep learning, computer vision tasks.
